name: InterContinental Shanghai Wonderland
insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's an architectural marvel built into the walls of an abandoned quarry, making it one of the world's most extraordinary underground luxury resorts.
whats_special: The InterContinental Shanghai Wonderland defies gravity as the world's first luxury hotel built downward into a quarry pit. Two floors sit underwater with stunning aquarium views, while the building cascades 18 stories below ground level. The engineering feat took over a decade to complete and features rooms with direct views of the quarry's dramatic rock faces and cascading waterfalls.
pro_tip: Book an underwater suite for the ultimate experience—you'll literally sleep below water level with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing marine life in the hotel's massive aquarium.
dont_miss: The bungee jumping platform that launches guests from the quarry rim, the hotel's dramatic glass facade that follows the quarry's natural contours, and the world-class spa treatments offered in chambers carved directly into the rock face. The rooftop offers stunning views of the Shanghai skyline and nearby Sheshan National Forest Park.
pros: World's first quarry hotel built into abandoned quarry pit
Stunning underwater suites with aquarium views
Dramatic cascading waterfall feature throughout property
Award-winning architectural marvel and engineering feat
